items.title: Ashton Jeanty: Questionable for Sunday
items.text:
Jeanty (ankle/foot) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Patriots, with Raiders coach Klint Kubiak saying Friday that the running back will "do his best to go,"Levi Edwards of the Raiders' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Chris Olave: Practicing again Friday
items.text:
Olave (rest/foot) appeared to be moving well during the part of Friday's practice open to the media, Jeff Nowak of WWL New Orleans reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jeremiyah Love: Trending well with ankle issue
items.text:
Head coach Mike LaFleur said Friday that Love (ankle) is "trending in the right direction" ahead of Sunday's game against the Lions, Tyler Drake of ArizonaSports.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tyler Huntley: Will start Week 5 against Atlanta
items.text:
Huntley will start Sunday night's game against the Falcons after Lamar Jackson (ankle) was ruled out Friday, Jeff Zrebiec of The Athletic Zrebiec reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Malik Nabers: Expected to play Sunday
items.text:
Head coach John Harbaugh said Friday that Nabers (knee) will "be ready to play Sunday" at Washington, Pat Leonard of the New York Daily News reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Lamar Jackson: Officially ruled out for Week 5
items.text:
Jackson (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday night's game against the Falcons, Cordell Woodland of 105.7 The Fan Baltimore reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson: Expects to play, Vrabel unsure
items.text:
Stevenson (knee) said Friday that he's "ready to go", while Patriots coach Mike Vrabel said the running back "is not out as of yet" for Sunday's game against Las Vegas, according to Mark Daniels of MassLive.com.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
